title: The Ash Sea
text: A sea of ash stretches ahead, grey and soft and endless, with long shapes moving under its surface. A devil sits on the shore in a boat of black bone, picking its teeth. It offers you passage. It does not mention the fare.

options.label: Take the devil's boat, and do not ask the fare. Some prices are best paid later.

outcomes.text: The crossing is fast and smooth. The fare comes due later, owed by everyone alike.

options.label: Wade across the ash instead, rather than owe a devil anything.

outcomes.text: The ash is hot, far hotter than it looks. Halfway across, something beneath its surface takes an interest in you.

options.label: The shrewdest haggles over the fare, certain no devil can outwit them.

outcomes.text: A fair price, paid in honest coin. The devil looks almost offended.
The devil haggles better, as devils always do. It smiles as it counts your coin.
